attributes.action: Protect the 10-Year Long Residence Route for People Already Living in the UK.
attributes.additional_details: We came to the UK relying on the promise that 10 years of lawful residence would provide a route to settlement. We have paid fees, taxes, worked hard and contributed to Britain's economy while following every rule. Abolishing this route now would break that promise and change the rules halfway through our journey. Please protect existing residents. Abolish it for future arrivals if necessary, or restrict benefits for five more years, but honour the commitment made to us.
attributes.background: Great Britain must honour the promise made to those who came here relying on the 10-year long residency route. Changing the rules now would break that promise. Abolish it for future arrivals if necessary, but do not abandon those who already trusted this pathway.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

Keep 10-year Long Residence Route for people already living in the UK
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/781255
